use IO.Std.write_line

union Tree is
    LEAF(value: int)
    NODE(left: Tree, right: Tree)

use Tree.LEAF
use Tree.NODE

use Comparison = COROUTINE[(same: bool, leaves: int)]

class WALKER is
    _tree: Tree
    _wanted: CHANNEL[bool]
    _leaves: CHANNEL[int?]

    init(tree: Tree) is
        _tree = tree
        _wanted = CHANNEL()
        _leaves = CHANNEL()
    si

    next() -> COROUTINE[int?] is
        _wanted.send(true)

        return await _leaves.receive()
    si

    walk() -> COROUTINE is
        await _emit(_tree)

        let _ = await _wanted.receive()

        _leaves.send(null)
    si

    _emit(tree: Tree) -> COROUTINE is
        if isa LEAF(tree) then
            let _ = await _wanted.receive()

            _leaves.send(tree.value)
        elif isa NODE(tree) then
            await _emit(tree.left)
            await _emit(tree.right)
        fi
    si

    let left = WALKER(first)
    let right = WALKER(second)

    left.walk()
    right.walk()

    let leaves mut = 0

    do
        let a = await left.next()
        let b = await right.next()

        if a? != b? then
            return (false, leaves)
        fi

        if !a? then
            return (true, leaves)
        fi

        leaves = leaves + 1

        if a !~ b then
            return (false, leaves)
        fi
    od

    case tree
    when (value): LEAF then "{value}"
    when (left, right): NODE then "({show(left)} {show(right)})"
    esac

let leaning_left = NODE(NODE(LEAF(1), LEAF(2)), LEAF(3))
let leaning_right = NODE(LEAF(1), NODE(LEAF(2), LEAF(3)))
let differs_last = NODE(LEAF(1), NODE(LEAF(2), LEAF(4)))
let differs_first = NODE(NODE(LEAF(9), LEAF(2)), LEAF(3))
let shorter = NODE(LEAF(1), LEAF(2))

    for (first, second) in [
        (leaning_left, leaning_right),
        (leaning_left, differs_last),
        (leaning_left, differs_first),
        (leaning_left, shorter)
    ] do

        let verdict = if same then "same fringe" else "different" fi
        let counted = if leaves == 1 then "leaf" else "leaves" fi

        write_line(
            "{show(first)} and {show(second)}: {verdict}, "
            "{leaves} {counted} compared")
